extracted.name: Basil cream cobbler
extracted.description: Great recipe for Basil cream cobbler.
instruction_lines: Season fish with salt, pepper, and dried basil. Set aside
On a large pan, sauté mushrooms until brown
Add garlic and onions. Cook until onions are translucent
Season with basil and add shrimp broth. Simmer to boil
Add all purpose cream, cook in low heat until thick and fragrant. Season as needed.
Coat fish in flour and fry till golden. Garnish with dried parsley. Serve with sauce and rice
